title: AC1027 Cover full reader pass; HEADER suffix still blocks strict output
scope: One local AC1027 source profile. Records successful full read after bounded HEADER, DataStorage, and DICTIONARY parser updates. It does not establish complete DXF export or support qualification.

headerEnvelope.acceptedProfile: declared size excludes the optional high-size word
headerEnvelope.validation: Alternate candidate passes CRC and ending-sentinel checks. The suffix is reported as unclaimed data and is not treated as padding. Strict-complete output rejects HeaderSectionUnclaimedData.

suffixAssessment.normativeSource: ODA Open Design Specification v5.4.1 sections 5.9 and 9: header handles use a separate stream; the documented HEADER section includes a CRC and ending sentinel.
suffixAssessment.independentReader: LibreDWG 0.14 parses Cover's known HEADER handle stream through logical byte 815; the CRC begins at byte 826 and the ending sentinel completes at byte 844. Its trace does not assign meaning to bytes 844–1575.
suffixAssessment.disposition: No producer-backed or normative meaning is established for the 731-byte suffix. Keep it unclaimed and fail strict-complete output closed; do not infer padding or corruption from absence of a known interpretation.

dataStorage.scope: The alternate selector requires the bounded contiguous layout and is limited to AC1027. ODA-described table order remains the default. Acceptance proves local parsing of this profile, not downstream semantic support.
